macros.name: cpyrght
macros.doc: This sets up the footer. It removes the page numbering, puts a horizontal bar at the bottom and adds ‘Name’ on the right-hand side.

macros.name: diagram
macros.doc: Gives a centred, bordered box containing the image ‘diag’.

macros.name: important
macros.doc: Produces a centred, coloured box and border containing ‘Text’, for anything you feel needs to be highlighted.

macros.name: intro
macros.doc: Divides the page into two columns, the first containing the ‘Text’ section, and the second the image ‘pic’.

macros.name: note
macros.doc: Produces a centred box with coloured background and border, containing the ‘Title’ text and ‘Text’.
